x: Jackie Brown's record was at no time in danger during this race. His record was made in conditions little better than this year's,- nevertheless the day saw some good performances.
Jackie Brown is now a 'vet' ,so it should now be a case of taking his "Brown Paper" and string along to the various road races and collecting the vet's 'pots'.
The team finished fourth, Chris Steer was fourth individual and 'old man' Jackie Brown convincingly won the Vet's prize. John Walker provided vocal accompaniment.
Jackie Brown must be one of the most formidable veteran runners in the country, and had little difficulty in winning over five miles at Hayes.

The Southern Counties Vets Championship was held at Havant, Hampshire on January 24th and John Baker placed 20th of the 40-odd starters in the over 50 group. Winner was Belgrave 2nd-claimer Jackie Brown.
The Bels. present were Colin Pearson, Clive Shippen, Alan and Marianne Black, Gordon Biscoe, Pam Davies, Alan Sexton, Ted Pallant, Alan Mead, Jackie Brown and Len and Gill Bishop.
…which stand out are Charlie Smart over 6 miles; sprinters Denis Merrett, Frank Kemp, Alan Sexton and Basil Walden while Jackie Brown and Charlie Walker appeared in the AAA mile championship.…
